text: No, the forest on this property is not being cleared today. The last observed tree-cover loss event occurred in 2021, where 81.3 hectares (2.23% of the property) were cleared, primarily from planted pine forests (*Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*). Since then, no further clearing has been detected in the most recent data (2025). The evidence shows that the event was corroborated by multiple sources (Hansen GFC and JRC GFC2020) and confirmed by Uruguay’s national forest map. While small patches of loss (under 0.5 ha) occurred in 2021, these were not classified as significant events. No activity has been observed in the intervening years.
